Hello @dheerajd-msys . I think I found the issue. It might be caused by the knife bootstrap command generating the client.rb file with a mix of '/' and '\' in the same paths

for example:

```chef_server_url  "https://chef-server.com/org"
validation_client_name "test-validator"
**file_cache_path   "C:\chef/cache"**
**file_backup_path  "C:\chef/backup"**
**cache_options     ({:path => "C:\chef/cache/checksums", :skip_expires => true})**
chef_license "accept"
node_name "Test"
log_level        :auto
log_location       STDOUT

**trusted_certs_dir "C:\chef/trusted_certs"**
```


By changing all the paths to use '/', I was able to successfully bootstrap by running chef-client command with different versions including latest. 

Please note that this only happens when running with knife bootstrap and the above client.rb is generated on the target node
Yes @kethahel99 That is the actual cause of the failure and we are working on to fix it per comment https://github.com/chef/chef/pull/10141#discussion_r453827586
